title: Don’t advertise the app if it’s not free for use
body: I am disappointed that the app promises all the good features once you finalize the test and then it asks you to sign up for a free trial period (which from what I read it’s not that easy - to cancel - as it sounds, adding additional stress for already stressed people). There should be an option to skip entirely and just use some features until a person decides on their own to sign up for a paid subscription (like Fabulous app has). Instead you waste people time and you make them disappointed (especially wrong when you claim the app to help ADHD people). That’s for a good experience.
author: Dorota Ch.
